scope.operation: Preserve native DXF/DWG OCS point fields when a caller reads DIMENSION with applyExtrusion enabled and then serializes the result.
behavior: DRW_Dimension::applyExtrusion transforms the modeled text, clone, and angular-arc OCS points to WCS and records the transformed state using the existing haveExtrusion flag; no object-layout or virtual-interface change is made.
DXF and DWG writers project only those transformed fields back into the native OCS frame before writing the extrusion vector; WCS definition fields remain unchanged.
Generated ASCII/Binary controls cover nine DIMENSION subtypes, four extrusion normals, raw and transformed read modes, output/readback, and a following-entity boundary sentinel.
A generated AC1015 DWG write/read control confirms the common text/clone OCS projection and the two-line angular-dimension arc point projection.

build.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip lc3_compat_check -j4

coverage: Local DWG round-trip aggregate, including DIMASSOC/object-carrier readback and surface subtype/retry assertions.
Generated ASCII and Binary DIMENSION mixed-frame read/write/readback in raw and applyExtrusion modes.
Generated AC1015 DWG write/read of applied-extrusion aligned text/clone points and angular arc point.
Generated ARC_DIMENSION flags, public OCS extrusion policy, modeler writer matrix, adapter capture limits, and writer version matrix.

validation.buildCommand: cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip lc3_compat_check --parallel 4

limitations: This receipt covers generated transport and coordinate-frame behavior only; it does not qualify physical producer prevalence, native dimension rendering, associative semantics, or broad format support.
No testing DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository; all generated DXFs were written under /private/tmp.
